_max_gather_seconds_note: 25→7 on 2026-08-14. The absolute ceiling is PORTABLE — it runs on uncalibrated CI hardware, so it must assume the slowest plausible runner and can only ever catch order-of-magnitude breakage. 25s against a 1.14s gather was 22x headroom, which let this corpus's own +50% boundaries regression (0.81s→1.21s) ship green. 7s is ~6x the slowest of n=5 runs on the reference machine (darwin-arm64, busy: min 1.111s, max 1.171s), absorbing a 4x-slower runner plus cold-cache margin. The ~1.5x class is caught by the same-machine baseline in internal/golden/perf.go, NOT by this number.
